symptom: A draft cleanup removed one historical demo run and could delete logs/state; it also claimed to preserve tracked files without checking Git.
root_cause: Treating generated business evidence as disposable build output; permissive destructive defaults and unvalidated arguments.
fix: Read-only by default; explicit --apply; allowlisted caches under first-party roots only; retain state/runs/logs/donors/archives and tracked contents; fail closed if Git tracking is unreadable.
prevention_rule: Housekeeping must leave business records intact, including ignored financial data and run evidence. Regressions exercise temporary fixtures before applying cleanup.

impact.scope: local handover workspace; one demo-order run removed before repair; no production database present

symptom: Console smoke intermittently failed despite GET / returning 200 and containing the expected title.
root_cause: With pipefail, grep -q could close its input before curl finished writing, turning a matching streamed body into a failed pipeline.
fix: Consume the complete successful HTTP response before the marker check; retain HTTP error detection.
prevention_rule: A large streaming response with a matching early title must pass the console smoke; a failed HTTP request with that title must still fail.

impact.scope: test harness; no product permission change or production data mutation

symptom: Remote Worker could queue real effect=deny/gate and unknown verdicts because only decision=deny was checked.
root_cause: Mocks used a different response shape from the real Sentinel endpoint; filename/unit completion mistaken for wiring.
fix: Normalize effect/decision, reject conflicting/invalid/exception results and hold gated runs; test real in-process response contract.
prevention_rule: No gate/deny/unknown or malformed verdict may become a queued run. All runtime seams need a real response-model contract test.

impact.scope: synthetic local regression only; no real provider actions executed

symptom: Stripe webhook accepted unsigned ledger writes when its signing secret was absent.
root_cause: Signature verification was conditional on a secret existing; absence bypassed authentication.
fix: Missing secret disables endpoint with 503; malformed/bad signatures still refuse.
prevention_rule: Unconfigured inbound credentials disable ingestion, never authorize it. Provider authenticity is still not accounting reconciliation.

impact.scope: one synthetic in-memory ledger row during pre-fix test, no real revenue/customer data

symptom: JSON bookkeeping printed successful rollout/reversible-migration/rollback claims without executing any infrastructure.
root_cause: Tests verified self-reported record fields, not deployment effects; mock product output treated as end-to-end completion.
fix: Explicit record-only CLI acknowledgement and honest record statuses; quarantine media by default and fail split with 501.
prevention_rule: A record or UI status is not execution evidence. Unsupported execution must refuse, not claim success.

impact.scope: source review and temporary fixtures only; no infrastructure changed
